Crime Branch Raids Homes in Kishtwar Minor Rape-Death Case

The Crime Branch conducted raids on the residences of two accused individuals in connection with the rape and death of a minor in Kishtwar. The investigation is focusing on the role of each accused. One report also mentioned the dismissal of a second hospital worker related to the case. The raids targeted the homes of accused brothers, with the investigation into their roles intensifying.
